questions: How should the CLI handle disabled Goals feature?
Where should the error handling be placed?

answers.answer: Reactive error handling: catch server 404 responses and display the extracted error message. No pre-flight check or local feature flag state.
evidence: product/product.md: SCN-06 — CLI shows friendly message instead of raw error

answers.answer: Wrapper try/catch in runGoals function around the switch statement. This covers all 5 commands consistently, including list and get which lack local try/catch blocks.
evidence: tech-research/tech-research.md (cli): Decision 2 — Wrapper try/catch in runGoals
src/goals/index.ts: switch statement at lines 28-89 has no wrapper catch

statement: The CLI implementation plan adds a try/catch wrapper in runGoals that uses parseApiError to display friendly error messages when the server returns 404 for disabled Goals. One file changed, no new dependencies.
